title: Market sushi farewell to Osaka · Nozomi to Tokyo · Harumiya yakatabune under the Odaiba fireworks · San-chōme alleys and karaoke

stops.name: Check out of Kujō House
stops.plan: Slow start after the Round1 all-nighter: overnight bags only (the suitcases left for Garfield House by TA-Q-BIN yesterday); check-out is 10:00.
stops.transport: Walk to the Osaka Central Wholesale Market (Noda), 20 min; or 2 taxis

stops.name: Endo Sushi (Central Market)
stops.plan: Osaka farewell brunch inside the wholesale market: the 5-piece omakase plates, ordered in rounds; may seat 8 in two groups. Cash only; open to 14:00 on Saturdays.
stops.transport: Walk to Awaza, Osaka Metro Chūō line → Hommachi, Midōsuji line → Shin-Osaka; 19 min door to door (2 taxis about 19 min). Spare time at Shin-Osaka for ekiben, beers and 551 Horai buta-man for the ride

stops.name: Nozomi Shinkansen Shin-Osaka → Tokyo
stops.plan: Nozomi around 12:30, 8 reserved seats in one car booked on smartEX (all seats are reserved Dec 25–Jan 5, so book the minute the window opens). Not covered by the Kansai-Hiroshima pass. Ekiben from Shin-Osaka station, then sleep it off; Mt Fuji on the right side.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi line Tokyo → Shinjuku-gyoemmae (Welcome Suica), walk to Garfield House; about 45 min door to door

stops.name: Check in to Garfield House
stops.plan: Check in at 16:00 sharp; the suitcases from Osaka arrive by TA-Q-BIN this evening. Bags down, warm layers on (it is cold on the river), passports in pockets, and out the door by 16:30: the boat will not wait.
stops.transport: Leave 16:30: Toei Shinjuku line Shinjuku-sanchōme → Ichigaya, JR Chūō-Sōbu local → Ryōgoku, walk to the Harumiya pier; about 49 min door to door, at the pier by about 17:20–17:30

stops.name: Yakatabune Harumiya dinner cruise
stops.plan: At the pier by 17:30 for the 17:45 gathering (late arrivals cannot board and are not refunded); sail 18:00 on the shared boat for 150 minutes: Furisode set dinner and unlimited drinks, past Skytree and out to Odaiba for the Rainbow Fireworks at 19:00 from the water. FALLBACK: the shared boat sails only with 15 guests, so if Harumiya cancels, book Funasei's shared yakatabune from Shinagawa (shared boats from 2 guests, phone 03-5479-2731, 10:00–19:00); rain fallback is TJPW at Korakuen Hall (18:30).
stops.price: ¥13,200 pp (Furisode set); Funasei fallback from ¥14,000 pp
stops.transport: Walk to JR Ryōgoku, Chūō-Sōbu local → Yotsuya, Tokyo Metro Marunouchi line → Shinjuku-sanchōme; about 41 min door to door

stops.name: Shinjuku San-chōme izakaya alleys
stops.plan: An easy nightcap round in the small alleys by Suehirotei: standing bars and yakitori counters, split 4+4 where needed. Already fed from the boat, so just drinks and a few skewers.

stops.name: Karaokekan Kabukicho Honten
stops.plan: One party room for 8, booked by LINE or phone (03-5285-7007) on the day; free-flow drinks, out by 00:25. Ignore the Kabukichō touts on the way.
stops.price: about ¥2,000 pp (room and drinks; check the rate on the day)
stops.transport: Walk home to Garfield House, 14 min

stops.name: Garfield House
stops.plan: Bed before 01:00: a real night's sleep after the Christmas all-nighter.
